sql: SELECT request_type, COUNT(*) AS requests, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_all FROM MONTGOMERY_READY.requests_311_2025 GROUP BY request_type ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_requests, COUNT(DISTINCT request_type) AS type_count FROM MONTGOMERY_READY.requests_311_2025
SELECT request_type, COUNT(*) AS requests FROM MONTGOMERY_READY.requests_311_2025 GROUP BY request_type ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 8
